_comment: COPY DECK for the Moon Whale Media promo campaign, built from per-product feature-inventory passes (2026-08-14). Each promo: id (stable, used for cooldown history), title (rendered ON the card), blurb (the caption), and optionally its own screenshot/capture_url for a feature-page shot (falls back to the product home shot). A product may also declare promos_file - an external JSON array of generated promos (CoderStudyFlow: one promo per track). The picker chooses a PRODUCT first (fair rotation regardless of deck size), then an eligible promo within it; nothing repeats within cooldown_days. Products whose screenshot is missing on disk are skipped. Captures come from Herd dev hosts until the production domains are live - recapture after each launch.
